mergedDocumentation.meaning: Published design and planning baseline only; neither merge is installed-runtime acceptance.

darwin-arm64.note: The shipping owner records the local installed gate as accepted. The accepted local bytes and notarized published bytes are distinct and remain explicitly recorded.

win32-x64.requiredObservation: Install the published 2.2.3 setup and confirm UAR launch plus effective-port reporting.

theBossMainProcess: application profile, workspace and conversation identity
provider credential lookup and request-scoped secret delivery
MCP connection ownership and immutable run catalog capture
host approval presentation, policy ceilings and exact tool admission
sidecar supervision, readiness, restart generation and shutdown
uar: governed execution loop and admitted run resources
run, step, invocation, child and cancellation lineage
ordered AG-UI emission, replay and explicit gap outcomes
runtime policy composition that the host may restrict but not enlarge
bossFang: BossFang workflow and kernel execution when it delegates a bounded UAR call
UAR provider adapter is not authority over the UAR execution loop
fabric: event transport and delivery only; no task or execution ownership
memory: scoped retrieval and retained memory only; no conversation or workflow authority

acceptance.blockingCondition: Published Windows x64 2.2.3 installed acceptance is still pending in the owning shipping phase.
allowedWhilePending: nonoverlapping work whose contract does not depend on D-UAR-P1
disallowedWhilePending: claiming release or runtime conformance from merged documentation
